name: Standing cable Pallof press
definition: Stand side-on to a chest-height cable with the handle held at the chest in both hands. Press the hands forward while maintaining trunk orientation, then draw them back.

catalogue_anchor.notes: Original broad muscle labels retained separately; not silently promoted to accepted anatomy.

value.start: Stand side-on to a chest-height cable with the handle held at the chest in both hands.
value.movement: Press the hands forward while maintaining trunk orientation, then draw them back.
value.finish: Return the handle to the chest before the next press; repeat facing the other direction separately.
value.range_of_motion: Defined hand travel with no intended trunk rotation; record any hold duration.
